title: Cantonese Stir-Fried Beans
description: A simple and flavorful Chinese dish made with haricot beans and a blend of aromatic spices. This recipe is perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add haricot beans and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until heated through.
Add chopped green onions and light soy sauce. Stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
